annotations.title: Check an image for AI records

description: Check an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF or single-page TIFF, up to 20 MiB) by public URL or base64 for C2PA Content Credentials, AI labels, saved generation settings and metadata. Evidence comes from records in the file, not a visual-only verdict. No public report is created. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp

image_base64.description: File bytes as base64 or a data: URL, up to 20 MiB decoded. Prefer url when the file is public.

url.description: Public http(s) URL. Private network and local addresses are refused.
